title: Schedule of Renewal, Cancellation and Refund Terms — Bridgewell Comfort Care Levels
content:
The renewal, cancellation, refund and transfer figures that apply to HVAC Maintenance Agreements at each level.

| Agreement level | Renewal notice, minimum days before term end | Late re-enrollment grace, days after term end | Cancellation admin fee after the free-look period (USD) | Free-look period, days after start date | Refund issued within, days after cancellation | Visit retail value (USD) | Transfers to a new owner of the property |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Comfort Care Essential | 30 | 30 | 25.00 | 30 | 30 | 129.00 | Yes |
| Bridgewell Comfort Care Standard | 30 | 30 | 25.00 | 30 | 30 | 129.00 | Yes |
| Bridgewell Comfort Care Plus | 30 | 30 | 25.00 | 30 | 30 | 149.00 | Yes |
| Bridgewell Comfort Care Dual-System | 30 | 30 | 25.00 | 30 | 30 | 129.00 | Yes |
| Bridgewell Comfort Care Dual-System Plus | 30 | 30 | 25.00 | 30 | 30 | 149.00 | Yes |
| Bridgewell Comfort Care Premier | 30 | 30 | 25.00 | 30 | 30 | 169.00 | Yes |

All day counts are calendar days.

## Terms defined

1. **Renewal notice days** — the minimum calendar days before term end by which the renewal notice must be issued for automatic renewal.
2. **Late renewal grace days** — the calendar days after term end during which an expired agreement may be re-enrolled without a new qualifying inspection.
3. **Cancellation admin fee** — the administrative fee deducted from a refund after the free-look period.
4. **Free-look days** — the calendar days after the start date within which a cancellation is refunded in full less visits used.
5. **Refund processing days** — the calendar days after cancellation within which a refund is issued.
6. **Visit retail value** — the retail value of one completed tune-up, deducted from a cancellation refund.
7. **Transfer allowed** — whether the agreement transfers to a new owner of the property.

## Differences between levels

The visit retail value is the only figure in this schedule that varies: 129.00 on Essential, Standard and Dual-System, 149.00 on Plus and Dual-System Plus, and 169.00 on Premier. Every other figure is the same on all six levels, and every level transfers to a new owner of the property.

## Schedule questions

**What is deducted for each completed tune-up when a Bridgewell Comfort Care Premier agreement is cancelled with a refund?** The visit retail value of that level, 169.00 per completed visit.

**What administrative fee applies on any level after the free-look period?** 25.00, deducted from the refund.
